name: Lord Baurles K. Wishock
summary: In Stormwind Keep, Lord Baurles K. Wishock moves among petitioners and dignitaries. His unpaid tavern tabs and taste for strong drink have brought him close to darker dealings in the city.

sections.title: A Nobleman's Dangerous Curiosity
sections.body: Lord Baurles K. Wishock belongs to the influential House of Nobles and moves among petitioners and dignitaries in Stormwind Keep. Yet he often drinks in Mage Quarter dive bars, especially the Slaughtered Lamb, and leaves large bills unpaid. There he hears of a warlock coven practicing dark arts in cellars beneath the floorboards. Wishock seeks to close the tavern and asks fellow nobles for a formal inquiry. Uncovering demonic cabals in Stormwind rarely goes unpunished.

sections.title: A Poisoned Cup
sections.body: Zardeth of the Black Claw arranges Lord Baurles K. Wishock’s quiet killing to avoid royal scrutiny and an inquiry into the coven’s underground sanctum. The warlocks exploit Wishock’s taste for luxury vintages and prepare a lethal drink disguised as fine ale. A hired adventurer is chosen to carry it to Wishock beneath the Keep guards’ noses.

faq.q: Who is Lord Baurles K. Wishock?
faq.answer: Lord Baurles K. Wishock belongs to the House of Nobles and spends his days in the Petitioner's Chamber inside Stormwind Keep. Mage Quarter barkeeps know him for his large, unpaid drinking tabs.

faq.q: Where can Lord Wishock be found?
faq.answer: Lord Baurles K. Wishock can be found in the Petitioner's Chamber on the eastern side of Stormwind Keep. Courtiers, diplomats, and supplicants gather there while awaiting royal attention.

faq.q: Why do the warlocks beneath the Slaughtered Lamb want him dead?
faq.answer: At the Slaughtered Lamb, Lord Baurles K. Wishock learns that a warlock coven operates beneath the tavern. He seeks a formal inquiry from the House of Nobles and wants the establishment closed, threatening to expose their operations.

Zardeth of the Black Claw prepares a deadly poison disguised as an exquisite drink. An agent carries the poisoned cask to Lord Baurles K. Wishock in Stormwind Keep, where his taste for fine alcohol and free drinks makes him an easy target.

angles.text: As a warlock, you know Lord Baurles K. Wishock’s investigation of the Slaughtered Lamb threatens Stormwind’s shadow coven. His quiet death becomes a priority for its members.
As a human, you see the House of Nobles’ decadent, self-serving reputation reflected in the Petitioner's Chamber during the boy-king Anduin’s early reign.
